description: Answers 'show me every NVDA trade on this day.' Give a symbol and a day (YYYY-MM-DD); optionally start/end times (HH:MM, US Eastern) to narrow the window, or omit day to list the days available. Returns every trade print (time in UTC nanoseconds and ISO, price, size, exchange, condition codes) for 1,100+ US stocks and ETFs over the last 5 years. Buyers get the trades; other keys get the day's trade count, first and last trade and the history options available. Free sample for every key: all trades on 2026-10-01 for SPY, QQQ, NVDA, AAPL, TSLA, MSFT, AMZN, META, AMD and IWM.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

day.description: Trading day YYYY-MM-DD; omit to list available days.

symbol.description: US stock or ETF, e.g. NVDA, SPY.

name: get_ticks
title: Get tick trades (every trade print)
